notes.title: Patch Notes July 4
notes.notes:
Hello valued employees! The first wave of bug fixes is now live. If you've experienced any of the following issues, they should be fixed now!
[list]
[*] Pressing the "Continue" button after a shift crashes the game
[*] You can get permanently stuck in a shelf with precise movement
[*] An NPC gives the wrong dialog on shift 7
[*] Malformed save data prevents opening the game
[*] Restarting the tutorial doesn't reset the shelves
[*] The tutorial can be completed early using the phone
[/list]
Please continue to let us know about any issues you encounter at retalefeedback@gmail.com! Thank you!
